scope_limits: This is a new heuristic benchmark, not old deployed-candidate equivalence or proof of profitability.
Input availability is not the time the derived candidate was computed; the separate observed-management plan must retain actual computation/persistence before outcome observation.
Caller must bind trusted quote observation and current registered source/model/cohort selection; this pure helper does not authorize execution.
Source and test review only; the owner performed the38-case run. No independent runtime or broker activity occurred.
verified_semantics: Frozen mapper validates exact retained MBA raw bytes, source receipt, metadata and original clocks.
Caller consumption binds exact raw/receipt hashes and completes after capture and before the declared decision.
Last13 real complete S5 rows must span55–70seconds; exact30/60second endpoint rows are mandatory without fill or fallback.
Reference price closes at original label+5; source age at decision is at most30seconds.
Current matching quote is explicitly tradeable with market/availability clocks before decision and at most5seconds market age.
Signed native-pip rate is0.5*move30/sqrt30 +0.5*move60/sqrt60, scaled by sqrt(actual remaining seconds<=3600).
Round-trip cost is current full spread plus two current-midpoint0.1bps slippage legs in native pips.
Score is magnitude/cost; bounded0.5–0.9 confidence is explicitly an uncalibrated score mapping, not probability or historical accuracy.
Momentum candidate carries positive magnitude, side, score, confidence, snapshot identity and original target expected by the existing generic momentum admission branch.
Neutral and unavailable cases carry explicit refusal records; inert flags and no broker-fill claim persist.
